summary: Analiza 20 najjacih MIDI projekata (gh api + README signal sken): pokrivenost generisanja (magenta 19800★, muzic 4951★, NotaGen, MidiTok, muspy, midi-model, sym-diffusion, MIDI-GPT), aranzera (JJazzLab LGPL, Cadenza/BandInMuseScore/Favorites-with-Style GPL, autoaccompany/fleet-midi-bass MIT) i analize (music21, pretty-midi, mido, musicaiz, mgeval). Zakljucak: niko ne pokriva evidencijsku optimizaciju postojecg fajla, Korg uloge, terca/echo trackove ni factory velocity autoritet; MIT projekti se mogu ugraditi uz atribuciju, GPL/AGPL/LGPL samo studija.

verdicts.reusableWithAttribution: mido, pretty-midi, music21, MidiTok, muspy, NotaGen, MIDI-GPT, autoaccompany, fleet-midi-bass, Muzic, magenta (mido vec u upotrebi kao dev-only verifikator)
verdicts.studyOnly: Cadenza, BandInMuseScore, Favorites-with-Style, expremigen, musicaiz, JJazzLab
nobodyCovers: evidence-gated optimization of an existing file
